title: A parking lot or a pump track? A Syracuse police project sparks outcry
summary: A dispute has emerged on Syracuse's West Side over proposed use of a gravel bike track site: the Syracuse Police Department plans to install a parking lot, while a developer and community advocates are opposing the project to preserve the pump track for neighborhood youth. The conflict highlights tensions between police infrastructure needs and community recreation/equity priorities in land-use decisions.
